summary: Scout's proposed prospects feel generic and interchangeable; they need to feel personal and show why this person, tied to what the wingman actually said.
quote: These all sound the same. "Loves travel, values honesty." Everybody says that. It feels generic. ... If my wingman said I love hiking, I want to see why this person, not the same three phrases. Otherwise why do I need Scout.
notes: Raised twice; strongest point of the demo (she questions Scout's value without it). She explicitly left the how to Tee ("You decide how"). Tee floated more interview questions or using more wingman input; that is Tee's idea, not her request.

summary: Adding a friend to the team is hard to find; she couldn't locate it (it's behind the + at top right) and wants it easier since the team is the core of the app.
quote: And how do I add a new friend to the team? I'm looking and I don't see it. ... It should be easier to add friends. That's the whole point, no? The team.
notes: Discoverability issue observed live: she looked for it and didn't find it.

summary: Unread badge on the chat icon doesn't clear after the message has been opened.
quote: The red number is still there. On the chat icon. You read it already. ... That will drive people crazy.
notes: Reproduced live in the demo; Tee agreed it should clear.

summary: Likes the match card as is: clean, shows photo, who suggested the match, and the reason. Asked that it not be changed.
quote: Oh, this I like. The card is clean, I see the photo, I see who suggested her, the reason. This is very clear. Don't touch it.
notes: Treat as a constraint: avoid changing the match card when working on other items.

summary: Asked whether Scout will be free or part of the subscription; says she would pay for it but expects users to ask the same question.
quote: Is the Scout thing going to be free? Or is it in the subscription? ... I would pay for it, but I'm not normal user. People will ask.
notes: Not a feature request. She flagged her own willingness to pay as unrepresentative. Tee said still deciding.
